title: How to Fix the "SYSTEM THREAD EXCEPTION NOT HANDLED" in Windows 10? - GeeksforGeeks
content:
On Windows, a special component is present that acts as a bridge between the Hardware & Software, known as Windows Drivers. The SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED Error can be found on the Windows Driver.

When any Windows Driver starts malfunctioning, you get a Driver Thread Exception Error on Windows on the Windows Blue Screen. This article will highlight the methods for dealing with the Windows System Thread Exception.

Table of Content

  • What is SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED Error on Windows?
  • How to Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows?
  • Method 1: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Identifying the Driver
  • Method 2: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows using Safe Mode
  • Method 3: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Rollback Driver
  • Method 4: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Memory Diagnostic
  • Method 5: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Checking Driver Health
  • Method 6: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by System Restore
  • Method 7: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Resetting Device

What is SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED Error on Windows?

The Windows SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED is a Stop Code Error that falls under the Windows Blue Screen Error umbrella. While working on the device, you might get the Windows Blue Screen stating the Error Code 0x0000007E or 0x1000007E. This means, there is no critical error with drivers.

The SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED Windows Error is different from the other 500 BSOD Windows Error as you can't identify which driver is causing the issue. Sometimes, one or more drivers start malfunctioning can trigger the error. In such cases, we have to first identify the problematic driver.

How to Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows?

To Resolve Stop Error SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows, the following methods & steps should be executed in the proper series. Let us start by Finding Out the the Problematic Driver.

Method 1: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Identifying the Driver

Step 1: On Windows OS, open the Run Window by pressing the Windows + R Button simultaneously. Now, execute the following command there. It will directly open the Windows Log Folder.

Command: eventvwr

Step 2: On the opened window, Expand the Windows Logs & click on the Systems. Under that option, find out which driver has the System Thread Windows Error Mark to identify it.

Method 2: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows using Safe Mode

Step 1: You have to first restart the device & when it is restarting start pressing the Del Button multiple times. You will enter into the Boot Menu. Now, click on the Troubleshoot option.

Step 2: After that, go for the Advanced Options.

Step 3: Now, click on the Startup Settings option to move ahead.

Step 4: You will find some options related to the Windows Safe Mode. Press the certain assigned key to enter into Safe Mode.

Method 3: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Rollback Driver

Step 1: As the driver is now identified, open Device Manager by right-clicking on the Start Windows Button.

Step 2: On the certain driver, right-click on it & go for the Properties option.

Step 3: Now, click on the Rollback Driver option to return to the previous version of the driver.

Method 4: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Memory Diagnostic

Step 1: On the Search Bar, search for the Windows Memory Diagnostic Tool & open the application.

Step 2: Just click on the Restart Now & Check Problems option to scan all the issues on the memory.

Method 5: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Checking Driver Health

Step 1: Search for the Command Prompt in the Windows Search Bar & open the application.

Step 2: First, execute the following command to check any issues present on the Driver & Disk of the Windows.

Command: DISM /Online /Cleanup-image /RestoreHealth

Step 3: Now, it is time to fix all the issues that have been identified by the above command. To do so, the following command will be used.

Command: sfc /scannow

Method 6: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by System Restore

Step 1: Search for the Recovery option under Control Panel on the Windows Search bar & open the settings.

Step 2: Click on the Open System Restore Option on the newly opened window.

Step 3: Click on the Next option without making any changes.

Step 4: Click on the Finish to complete the process & start the System Restore.

Method 7: Fix SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Windows by Resetting Device

Step 1: Open Windows Settings & go for the Update & Security option.

Step 2: Click on the Get Started under the Reset The PC option.

Step 3: Click on the Keep My Files option to start the Reset Process.

If you followed up all the above methods in the correct sequence, you should have come out from the SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION Driver Problem on Windows. Also, it should be now clear to you that the SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED is not a complicated task to resolve without the help of the technicians.
